claims: BINI is the first all-Filipino group to perform at the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
BINI debuted in the Mojave tent on April 10, 2026.
BINI consists of Aiah, Colet, Maloi, Gwen, Stacey, Mikha, Jhoanna, and Sheena.
BINI has a second performance scheduled for April 17, 2026.
BINI became the first Filipino act to perform at the Coachella stage.
BINI delivered a 42-minute, 10-song setlist including "Shagidi," "Zero Pressure," "Out of My Head," "Karera," "Salamin, Salamin," "Blink Twice," "Cherry on Top," "Blush," "Bikini," and "Pantropiko".
BINI's performance took place on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Mojave tent was packed with fans (BLOOMs) cheering for BINI.
BINI members expressed a sense of responsibility in representing the Philippines.
BINI greeted the Coachella audience with "Mabuhay".
BINI's show was featured on the official Coachella YouTube Channel.
